items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« يَنْبَغِي لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يُسْمِعَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ اَلتَّشَهُّدَ وَ لاَ يُسْمِعُونَهُ شَيْئاً»

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-‘Ubaydi, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from al-Husayn, from his father Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Madi (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man, whether it is proper for him to recite aloud the ‘tashahhud’ and the statements in ‘ruku’, ‘sujud’, and ‘qunut’. Imam (a.s) said: “If he wishes, he may recite aloud, and if he wishes, he may not recite aloud.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى اَلْعُبَيْدِيِّ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْمَاضِيَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَجْهَرَ بِالتَّشَهُّدِ وَاَلْقَوْلِ فِي اَلرُّكُوعِ وَاَلسُّجُودِ وَاَلْقُنُوتِ قَالَ« إِنْ شَاءَ جَهَرَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَجْهَرْ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: “It is not appropriate for the imam (of prayer) to move (from his place) after the taslim until those behind him complete their prayer.” He (al-Halabi) said: “I asked Him (a.s) about the man who leads others in prayer, should he engage in ta‘qib with his companions after the taslim?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should recite tasbih, and whoever wishes may go to attend to his need, and no man should remain seated for the sake of the Imam’s ta‘qib.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يَنْبَغِي لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَنْتَقِلَ إِذَا سَلَّمَ حَتَّى يُتِمَّ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ اَلصَّلاَةَ» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَؤُمُّ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ هَلْ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يُعَقِّبَ بِأَصْحَابِهِ بَعْدَ اَلتَّسْلِيمِ فَقَالَ« يُسَبِّحُ وَ يَذْهَبُ مَنْ شَاءَ لِحَاجَتِهِ وَ لاَ يُعَقِّبُ رَجُلٌ لِتَعْقِيبِ اَلْإِمَامِ»

items.e: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Basir: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: “Any man who leads a group (in prayer) is required to remain seated after the taslim and not leave that spot until those behind him who had missed part of their prayer have completed it. This is obligatory upon every imam (of prayer) when he knows that among them is someone who has missed part of the prayer. But if he knows that there is no one among them who has missed part of the prayer, then he may go wherever he wishes.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ أَمَّ قَوْماً فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَقْعُدَ بَعْدَ اَلتَّسْلِيمِ وَ لاَ يَخْرُجَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ اَلْمَوْضِعِ حَتَّى يُتِمَّ اَلَّذِينَ خَلْفَهُ اَلَّذِينَ سُبِقُوا صَلاَتَهُمْ ذَلِكَ عَلَى كُلِّ إِمَامٍ وَاجِبٌ إِذَا عَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيهِمْ مَسْبُوقاً وَ إِنْ عَلِمَ أَنْ لَيْسَ فِيهِمْ مَسْبُوقاً بِالصَّلاَةِ فَلْيَذْهَبْ حَيْثُ شَاءَ»

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hadid, from Mansur ibn Yunus, from the one who narrated it from him: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: “Whoever performs an obligatory prayer and remains in ta‘qib until the (time of) the next (prayer), then he is the guest of Allah (swt), Mighty and Exalted, and it is a right upon Allah (swt), the Exalted, to honor His (swt) guest.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ يُونُسَ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ صَلَّى صَلاَةً فَرِيضَةً وَعَقَّبَ إِلَى أُخْرَى فَهُوَ ضَيْفُ اَللَّهِ عَزَّوَ جَلَّ وَحَقٌّ عَلَى اَللَّهِ تَعَالَى أَنْ يُكْرِمَ ضَيْفَهُ»

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah: Abu Ja‘far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Supplication after the obligatory prayer is better than performing voluntary prayer.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلدُّعَاءُ بَعْدَ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ تَنَفُّلاً»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah from Sama‘ah, who said: (it was said) “It is appropriate for the Imam to remain (seated) before speaking to anyone until he sees that those behind him have completed their prayer, then he may depart.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ:« يَنْبَغِي لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَلْبَثَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَ أَحَداً حَتَّى يَرَى أَنَّ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ قَدْ أَتَمُّوا اَلصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفُ هُوَ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah from Aban from Shihab ibn Abd Rabbih and Abdullah ibn Sinan, both from al-Walid ibn Sabih: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: “Ta‘qib is more effective in seeking sustenance than traveling through the lands (in search of it).”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ شِهَابِ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ وَ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ كِلَيْهِمَا عَنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ بْنِ صَبِيحٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلتَّعْقِيبُ أَبْلَغُ فِي طَلَبِ اَلرِّزْقِ مِنَ اَلضَّرْبِ فِي اَلْبِلاَدِ»

items.e: And from him, from Safwan, from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them: (Imam (a.s) said) “Supplication after the obligatory prayer is better than supplication after the recommended prayer, just as the obligatory prayer is superior to the recommended one.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلدُّعَاءُ دُبُرَ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ اَلدُّعَاءِ دُبُرَ اَلتَّطَوُّعِ كَفَضْلِ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ عَلَى اَلتَّطَوُّعِ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from al-Rabi‘ ibn Zakariyya al-Katib from Abdullah ibn Muhammad: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: “People have not practiced anything more demanding than ta‘qib.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلرَّبِيعِ بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا اَلْكَاتِبِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَا عَالَجَ اَلنَّاسُ شَيْئاً أَشَدَّ مِنَ اَلتَّعْقِيبِ»

items.e: And from him, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “Two men began the prayer at the same time. One of them recited the Qur’an, and his recitation was more than his supplication. The other supplicated more, and his supplication was more than his recitation. Then they both concluded (their prayers) at the same time. Which of them is superior?” Imam (a.s) said: “Each has merit. Each is good.” I asked: “I know that each is good and that each has merit, but..” Imam (a.s) said: “Supplication is superior. Have you not heard the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Exalted: ‘And your Lord said: Call upon Me, I will respond to you. Surely those who are too proud to worship Me will enter Hell in humiliation’? (Surah Ghafir 40:60). By Allah (swt), it is worship! By Allah (swt), it is superior! By Allah (swt), it is superior! Is it not worship? By Allah (swt), it is worship! By Allah (swt), it is worship! Is it not the most intense of them? By Allah (swt), it is the most intense of them. By Allah (swt), it is the most intense of them.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلَيْنِ اِفْتَتَحَا اَلصَّلاَةَ فِي سَاعَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ فَتَلاَ هَذَا اَلْقُرْآنَ فَكَانَتْ تِلاَوَتُهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ وَ دَعَا هَذَا أَكْثَرَ فَكَانَ دُعَاؤُهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ تِلاَوَتِهِ ثُمَّ اِنْصَرَفَا فِي سَاعَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ أَيُّهُمَا أَفْضَلُ قَالَ« كُلٌّ فِيهِ فَضْلٌ كُلٌّ حَسَنٌ» قُلْتُ إِنِّي قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ كُلاًّ حَسَنٌ وَ أَنَّ كُلاًّ فِيهِ فَضْلٌ فَقَالَ« اَلدُّعَاءُ أَفْضَلُ أَ مَا سَمِعْتَ قَوْلَ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ« وَ قٰالَ رَبُّكُمُ اُدْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إِنَّ اَلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبٰادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دٰاخِرِينَ» هِيَ وَ اَللَّهِ اَلْعِبَادَةُ هِيَ وَ اَللَّهِ أَفْضَلُ هِيَ وَ اَللَّهِ أَفْضَلُ أَ لَيْسَتْ هِيَ اَلْعِبَادَةَ هِيَ وَ اَللَّهِ اَلْعِبَادَةُ هِيَ وَ اَللَّهِ اَلْعِبَادَةُ أَ لَيْسَتْ هِيَ أَشَدَّهُنَّ هِيَ وَ اَللَّهِ أَشَدُّهُنَّ هِيَ وَ اَللَّهِ أَشَدُّهُنَّ»

items.e: And from him, from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, who said: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: “Whoever recites the Tasbih of Fatimah al-Zahra (s.a), peace be upon her, before folding his legs after the obligatory prayer will be forgiven. And he should begin with the takbir.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« مَنْ سَبَّحَ تَسْبِيحَ فَاطِمَةَ اَلزَّهْرَاءِ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَثْنِيَ رِجْلَيْهِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ وَ يَبْدَأُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from a group of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Yahya ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man from Ibn Abi Najran from a man: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: “Whoever glorifies Allah (swt) after the obligatory prayer with the Tasbih of Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, one hundred times, and follows it with ‘La ilaha illallah ‘ (There is no god but Allah (swt)), Allah (swt) will forgive him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ سَبَّحَ اَللَّهَ فِي دُبُرِ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ تَسْبِيحَ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلْمِائَةَ وَ أَتْبَعَهَا بِلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ غَفَرَ اَللَّهُ لَهُ»

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il ibn Bazi‘, from Salih ibn ‘Uqbah, from Abu Harun al-Makfuf: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: “O Abu Harun, we instruct our children to (recite) the Tasbih of Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, just as we instruct them to perform the prayer. So adhere to it, for no servant adheres to it and becomes wretched.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هَارُونَ اَلْمَكْفُوفِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« يَا أَبَا هَارُونَ إِنَّا نَأْمُرُ صِبْيَانَنَا بِتَسْبِيحِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ كَمَا نَأْمُرُهُمْ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَالْزَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَلْزَمْهُ عَبْدٌ فَشَقِيَ»

items.e: And through this same chain of transmission, from Salih ibn ‘Uqbah: Abu Ja‘far (a.s) said: “Allah (swt) has not been worshipped with anything of praise better than the Tasbih of Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, and had there been anything better than it, the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, would have gifted it to (Sayyida) Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her.”
items.o: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَ قَالَ:« مَا عُبِدَ اَللَّهُ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ اَلتَّحْمِيدِ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ تَسْبِيحِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ لَوْ كَانَ شَيْءٌ أَفْضَلَ مِنْهُ لَنَحَلَهُ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ»

items.e: And from him, from Abu Khalid al-Qammat, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say: “The Tasbih of Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, every day after every prayer is more beloved to me than performing a thousand rak‘ahs of prayer each day.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ اَلْقَمَّاطِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« تَسْبِيحُ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ صَلاَةِ أَلْفِ رَكْعَةٍ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from a group of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Amr ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir, who said: I entered with my father upon Abu Abdillah (a.s), and my father asked Him (a.s) about the Tasbih of Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her. Imam (a.s) said: ‘Allahu Akbar’ - Until He (a.s) counted thirty-four times. Then Imam (a.s) said: ‘Alhamdulillah’ - Until He (a.s) reached sixty-eight. Then Imam (a.s) said: ‘Subhanallah’ - Until He (a.s) completed one hundred. He (a.s) would count them with his hand all together as one sequence.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَسَأَلَهُ أَبِي عَنْ تَسْبِيحِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ« اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ» حَتَّى أَ حْصَى أَرْبَعاً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً ثُمَّ قَالَ« اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ» حَتَّى بَلَغَ سَبْعاً وَ سِتِّينَ ثُمَّ قَالَ« سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ» حَتَّى بَلَغَ مِائَةً يُحْصِيهَا بِيَدِهِ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: “You begin with the takbir thirty-four times, then the tahmid thirty-three times, then the tasbih thirty-three times.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع قَالَ:« تَبْدَأُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ أَرْبَعاً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ ثُمَّ اَلتَّحْمِيدِ ثَلاَثاً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ ثُمَّ اَلتَّسْبِيحِ ثَلاَثاً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd and al-Hasan ibn Sa‘id from Zur‘ah from Abu Basir: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: “Say after the tasleem (concluding the prayer), ‘Allah (swt) is the Greatest. There is no god but Allah (swt), alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him (swt) belongs all praise. He (swt) gives life and causes death, and He (swt) is the Living who does not die. In His (swt) hand is all good, and He has power over all things. There is no god but Allah (swt), alone. He (swt) fulfilled His (swt) promise, and aided His (swt) servant, and defeated the confederates alone. O Allah (swt), guide me to the truth concerning that in which there is disagreement, by Your (swt) permission. Indeed, You (swt) guide whom You (swt) will to the straight path."
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ وَاَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْ بَعْدَ اَلتَّسْلِيمِ« اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ« لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ اَللّٰهُ» وَحْدَهُ« لاٰ شَرِيكَ لَهُ»« لَهُ اَلْمُلْكُ وَ لَهُ اَلْحَمْدُ»« يُحْيِي وَ يُمِيتُ» وَ هُوَ حَيٌّ لاَ يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ اَلْخَيْرُ« وَ هُوَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ» لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ صَدَقَ وَعْدَهُ وَ نَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَ هَزَمَ اَلْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ اَللَّهُمَّ اِهْدِنِي لِمَا اُخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ اَلْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ»

items.e: And from him, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan ibn Mihran al-Jammal, who said: I saw Abu Abdillah (a.s), when He (a.s) completed his prayer, raise both his hands above his head.
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ اَلْجَمَّالِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِذَا صَلَّى فَفَرَغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ جَمِيعاً فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Mu‘awiyah ibn Shurayh from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb from ‘Amr ibn Nahik from Sallam al-Makki: Abu Ja‘far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “A man came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, whose name was Shaybah al-Hudhali, and he said: “O Messenger of Allah (swt), I am an old man; my age has advanced, and my strength has weakened from the acts I had trained myself upon, prayer, fasting, Hajj, and jihad. So teach me, O Messenger of Allah (swt), some words by which Allah (swt) will benefit me and lighten (the burden) upon me, O Messenger of Allah (swt).” He (saws) replied: “Repeat (what you said).” So he repeated it three times. Then the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said to him: “There is not a tree or a clod of earth around you except that it has wept out of mercy for you. So when you have prayed the morning prayer, say ten times: ‘Subhana Allah al-azim wa bihamdih, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah al-Aliyy al-‘Azim’ (Glory be to Allah (swt), the Almighty, and with His (swt) praise. There is no power and no strength except with Allah (swt), the Most High, the Most Great.) Indeed, with this Allah (swt) will protect you from blindness, insanity, leprosy, poverty, and decrepitude.” The man said: “O Messenger of Allah (swt), that is for this world, so what about the Hereafter?” He (saws) said: “Say after every prayer: ‘O Allah (swt), guide me from Yourself (swt), pour upon me from Your (azj) bounty, spread upon me from Your (azj) mercy, and send down upon me from Your (azj) blessings.’” He (the narrator) said: So He (saws) grasped them in his hand and walked on. A man said to Ibn ‘Abbas: "How tightly your uncle clung to them!" He said: Then the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: “Indeed, if he meets (his Lord (azj)) on the Day of Resurrection having preserved them and not having deliberately abandoned them, Allah (swt) will open for him eight gates from the gates of Paradise, and he will enter through whichever of them he wishes.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ نَهِيكٍ عَنْ سَلاَّمٍ اَلْمَكِّيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« أَتَى رَجُلٌ إِلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُقَالُ لَهُ شَيْبَةُ اَلْهُذَيْلِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ إِنِّي شَيْخٌ قَدْ كَبِرَ سِنِّي وَ ضَعُفَتْ قُوَّتِي عَنْ عَمَلٍ كُنْتُ قَدْ عَوَّدْتُهُ نَفْسِي مِنْ صَلاَةٍ وَ صِيَامٍ وَ حَجٍّ وَ جِهَادٍ فَعَلِّمْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ كَلاَماً يَنْفَعُنِي اَللَّهُ بِهِ وَ خَفِّفْ عَلَيَّ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ فَقَالَ« أَعِدْ» فَأَعَادَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ« مَا حَوْلَكَ شَجَرَةٌ وَلاَ مَدَرَةٌ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ بَكَتْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ فَإِذَا صَلَّيْتَ اَلصُّبْحَ فَقُلْ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ اَلْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ اَلْعَلِيِّ اَلْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ يُعَافِيكَ بِذَلِكَ مِنَ اَلْعَمَى وَ اَلْجُنُونِ وَاَلْجُذَامِ وَ اَلْفَقْرِ وَ اَلْهَرَمِ» فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ هَذَا لِلدُّنْيَا فَمَا لِلْآخِرَةِ فَقَالَ« تَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ اَللَّهُمَّ اِهْدِنِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَ أَفِضْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَ اُنْشُرْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ أَنْزِلْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ» قَالَ فَقَبَضَ عَلَيْهِنَّ بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ مَضَى فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ شَدَّ مَا قَبَضَ عَلَيْهَا خَالُكَ قَالَ فَقَالَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ« أَمَا إِنَّهُ إِنْ وَافَى بِهَا يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ لَمْ يَدَعْهَا مُتَعَمِّداً فَتَحَ اَللَّهُ لَهُ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَبْوَابٍ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ اَلْجَنَّةِ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أَيِّهَا شَاءَ»»

items.e: And from him, from Safwan, from Ibn Bukayr, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), regarding the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Exalted: ‘Remember Allah (swt) with much remembrance’ (Surah Ahzab 33:41), what is meant by “much remembrance”? Imam (a.s) said: “That one says tasbih (subhanAllah) thirty times after the obligatory prayer.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَوْلُ اَللَّهِ عَزَّوَ جَلَّ« اُذْكُرُوا اَللّٰهَ ذِكْراً كَثِيراً» مَاذَا اَلذِّكْرُ اَلْكَثِيرُ قَالَ« أَنْ يُسَبِّحَ فِي دُبُرِ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ ثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً»
